jei.taintedmagic.info.crystal_blood: Dropped by mobs killed with a Bloodlust-inscribed blade: up to a few drops per kill.
jei.taintedmagic.info.fluxed_shard: No longer made: Fluxed Shards became Vitium vis crystals. Kept so old worlds keep theirs.
jei.taintedmagic.info.thaumic_disassembl: Mines every kind of block. Use it while sneaking to cycle its mining speed. It mends itself by drawing Perditio vis from your wand.
jei.taintedmagic.info.voidwalker_sash: Worn in the Curios belt slot. Sneak and use it to switch its speed boost on or off.
jei.taintedmagic.info.warped_shard: No longer made: Warped Shards became Alienis vis crystals. Kept so old worlds keep theirs.
jei.taintedmagic.info.warpwood_leaves: Part of a grown Warpwood tree. Drops Warpwood saplings now and then.
jei.taintedmagic.info.warpwood_log: Cut from a grown Warpwood tree. Glows faintly.
jei.taintedmagic.info.warpwood_sapling: Infused (see the Thaumonomicon), then planted: grows into a Warpwood tree with a crown of purple leaves. Warpwood does not generate in the world.
research.taintedmagic.bloodlust.stage_0: Some of what I have built is hungry.
research.taintedmagic.bloodlust.stage_1: The Crystal Dagger and the Crimson Blade make every kill shed up to four phials of crystal blood. So does the Mage's Mace effect cast with its Bloodlust setting. Which blades count is the taintedmagic:bloodlust item tag.
research.taintedmagic.bloodlust.title: Bloodlust
research.taintedmagic.cap_cloth.stage_0: Enchanted fabric already holds magic loosely. Wrapped tight around the ends of a rod it might hold vis in as well as any metal ring.
research.taintedmagic.cap_cloth.stage_1: Five pieces of enchanted fabric make a Satin Wand Cap. It is the cheapest cap there is and still shaves a twentieth off every vis cost. Its softer cousins, of shadow-imbued and crimson cloth, do better.
research.taintedmagic.cap_cloth.title: Satin Wand Caps
research.taintedmagic.cap_crimsoncloth.s: Cloth that has drunk blood ought to hold vis greedily.
Crimson-stained cloth wrapped around salis mundus makes a cap that cuts vis costs by more than a tenth, better than thaumium for a fraction of the effort.
research.taintedmagic.cap_shadowcloth.st: Metal is not the only thing a wand can be capped with. Cloth that has drunk in enough magic should hold the ends of a rod just as well.

Shadowcloth wrapped around a pinch of salis mundus makes a soft wand cap. It is cheap to make and trims every vis cost by a tenth, a little better than gold. Fit it to any rod at the arcane workbench like a metal cap.
research.taintedmagic.cap_shadowmetal.st: Void metal caps already make a wand miserly with vis. Shadowmetal sits even further outside the world.

A void metal cap infused with four shadowmetal ingots, void metal, an Alienis vis crystal and a primordial pearl becomes a Shadowmetal Cap. A wand fitted with a pair spends only seven tenths of the usual vis, the best of any cap I know.
research.taintedmagic.creation.stage_0: Something in the shard answered when I touched it.
research.taintedmagic.creation.stage_1: My notes from that night are hard to read. The shard showed me a world before this one, made by beings who wove vis the way we breathe, and who paid for every working in warp. They split their making in two: the matter became this world, the raw power became the void beyond the eldritch gate, and the pearls are the seams where the two were stitched. A shard can still shape small things: the hours of the day, the weather, the stuff of the void itself.
research.taintedmagic.creation.title: Creation
research.taintedmagic.creation_shard.sta: The primordial pearl is not a gem. It is a seed, and seeds can be split.
Infusing a primordial pearl with a nether star and crystals of all six primals cracks it into two Shards of Creation. Handling one marks the mind deeply.
research.taintedmagic.crimson_blade.stag: The cult's officers carry a blade of void metal stained red. I think I can make one.
A void sword infused with my crystal dagger, crystal blood and crimson plating becomes a Crimson Blade. Like the dagger, it bleeds its kills into crystal.
research.taintedmagic.crimson_cloth.stag: The crimson cult dyes its robes in something that is not dye. The crystalline blood left behind by certain blades looks like it would do.
Enchanted fabric soaked in four phials of crystal blood becomes Crimson-stained Cloth. The cult's robes and plate can be made from it, and it makes a better wand cap than satin.
research.taintedmagic.crimson_robes.stag: The cult's robes are only cloth, and I now know how they dye it.
Crimson-stained cloth, with a little iron and gold, makes the hooded robes, leggings and boots the crimson cult wears, with all the warding and vis discount the cultists enjoy.
research.taintedmagic.crystal_dagger.sta: The crimson cult bleed their victims into crystal. Their knives are not hard to copy.
A void metal point set on an essentia crystallizer makes a slim dagger. Whatever it kills sheds phials of crystal blood.
research.taintedmagic.focus_eldritch.sta: What waits outside the world does not burn or freeze. It simply takes.
The Eldritch effect strikes with magic from outside the world and leaves its target withered and weak. It is strong, and it is not cheap.
research.taintedmagic.focus_mage_mace.st: Every thaumaturge has, at some point, simply hit something with their wand. It could be made to count.
The Mage's Mace effect lands a heavy physical blow, best delivered by touch. With bloodlust set, a quarter of the damage it deals flows back to me as health.
Weather is air and water in a mood. Moods can be changed.
The Meteorology effect clears a rainy sky or brings rain to a clear one for about half a day. It is expensive.
research.taintedmagic.focus_taint.stage_: Flux is only vis that has gone sour. Shaped the way I shape any other spell, it should sour whatever it touches.

The Taint effect strikes with corrosive magic and leaves its target sick with flux taint and poison. Its strength, how long the sickness lasts and how deep it bites can all be raised at the focal manipulator. Bubbles of it make a fine spray.
research.taintedmagic.focus_taint.title: Focus: Taint
research.taintedmagic.focus_tainted_blas: Taint pushed out all at once instead of a bubble at a time ought to knock the world flat.

The Tainted Shockwave effect bursts out ten blocks from where it lands, two more per step of radius, dealing magic damage to every foe in reach and throwing them away from the centre. Cast with the self delivery it clears a space around me.
research.taintedmagic.focus_time.stage_0: The day runs on a clock, and clocks can be wound.
research.taintedmagic.focus_time.stage_1: The Time effect pushes the world's clock half a day forward, turning noon into midnight and back. It costs a great deal of vis and only works where there is a sky.
research.taintedmagic.focus_time.title: Focus: Time
research.taintedmagic.focus_vis_shard.st: Vis squeezed hard enough forms crystals. Thrown, a crystal is a blade.
The Vis Crystal effect deals cheap, plain magic damage. Paired with a projectile and the homing modifier it behaves like the old shard focus, chasing its mark.
research.taintedmagic.fortress_trappings: The masks and lenses I fit to thaumium fortress helms should sit just as well on the void and shadow helms.

A void or shadow fortress helm can be infused with goggles of revealing so it shows auras and aspects, or with one of three masks. The Grinning Devil often turns warp's afflictions away, the Angry Ghost withers whoever strikes its wearer, and the Sipping Fiend sometimes heals its wearer when they draw blood. A mask also tightens the fortress set.
research.taintedmagic.inscription_fire.s: A katana's spine has room for one inscription, cut and filled by infusion.

Infuse any katana to give it this inscription (a new one replaces the old). A full wind-up now ends in a burst of flame wherever the cut lands, as far as I can see. It scorches creatures and leaves the stone alone. The inscription only answers a full wind-up made standing, not crouched.
A katana's spine has room for one inscription, cut and filled by infusion.

Infuse any katana to give it this inscription (a new one replaces the old). A full wind-up now lashes taint over everything in a cone before me: a share of the cut each, and the flux sickness after. The inscription only answers a full wind-up made standing, not crouched.
research.taintedmagic.inscription_undead: A katana's spine has room for one inscription, cut and filled by infusion.

Infuse any katana to give it this inscription (a new one replaces the old). A full wind-up now drinks a quarter of the wound it deals back into me. The inscription only answers a full wind-up made standing, not crouched.
research.taintedmagic.knight_robes.stage: The cult's knights wear plate over their robes. Iron soaked in crystal blood looks like what they use.
An iron ingot infused with four phials of crystal blood becomes Crimson Plating. Plating over crimson-stained cloth makes the knights' helm, cuirass and greaves.
research.taintedmagic.knight_robes.title: Crimson Knight Plate
research.taintedmagic.magic_funguar.stag: Vishrooms taste of nothing. With the right company they might taste of everything.

A vishroom baked with both common mushrooms, blaze powder and any vis crystal makes a Magic Funguar. It can be eaten even on a full stomach, heals quickly, quickens hands and feet, and leaves a trace of one primal aspect in my mind to research with.
research.taintedmagic.praetor_armor.stag: The cult's leaders wear something grander than their knights.
Knight plate infused with gold, more plating and crimson cloth becomes the Praetor's helm, cuirass and greaves.
research.taintedmagic.primordial_edge.st: The primal crusher holds the six primals in balance. A blade built around it would hold the world in the same grip.

A void sword infused with the primal crusher and crystals of all six primals becomes the Primordial Edge. It mends itself, its cuts wither and weaken, and while I hold it raised everything within fifteen blocks is dragged toward me and bitten when it arrives. It carries five points of warp.
research.taintedmagic.rod_warpwood.stage: Warpwood is hungry. Shaped into a wand core it should pull vis out of the same place the warp in my head comes from.

A warpwood log infused with a primordial pearl, shadowmetal, void metal, Alienis vis crystals and a brain becomes a Warpwood Wand Core. It holds 250 vis and glows faintly. It slowly refills every primal on its own; the more permanent warp its holder carries, the faster it refills, down to a few seconds. A warp ward starves it.
research.taintedmagic.rod_warpwood.title: Warpwood Wand Cores
research.taintedmagic.rod_warpwood_staff: Two warpwood cores bound end to end around a primordial pearl should make a staff with room for twice the vis.

Two warpwood wand cores and a primordial pearl at the arcane workbench make a Warpwood Staff Core. It holds 500 vis, glows with runes and refills itself from its holder's warp exactly as the wand core does.
research.taintedmagic.shadow_cloth.stage: Enchanted fabric takes on the nature of whatever it is woven against. Woven against shadowmetal, it ought to take on its darkness.

Three bolts of enchanted fabric pressed between two shadowmetal ingots at the arcane workbench give a dark, supple cloth that never quite holds a reflection. It is the base for the tainted robes and cloth caps to come.
research.taintedmagic.shadow_cloth.title: Shadow-imbued Cloth
research.taintedmagic.shadow_fortress_ar: Void Fortress plate forgets its wounds. Shadowmetal plate would never take them in the first place.

Void metal armour infused with blocks of shadowmetal becomes Shadow Fortress armour, the strongest plate I can make. Each piece turns aside a good share of magic, fire and blasts, trims vis costs and weighs on the mind with five points of warp. Worn as a set the pieces brace each other, more so with a mask on the helm.
research.taintedmagic.shadowmetal.stage_: Plain stone dropped into a crucible thick with darkness and void comes out changed: heavier, colder, and threaded with something that drinks the light.

Stone takes on Vacuos, Tenebrae, Metallum and Praecantatio in the crucible and becomes Shadow Ore. Smelted, it yields an ingot of Shadowmetal, a metal that seems to sit half a step outside the world. Nine ingots pack into a block.
research.taintedmagic.shadowmetal.title: Shadowmetal
research.taintedmagic.shadowmetal_katana: A shadowmetal sword folded into a katana. I will not show it to anyone.
The shadowmetal katana is the deadliest blade I can make and seven points of warp in the hand. Its cuts slow the victim to a crawl and smear their sight.
An ingot that drinks light should hold an edge like nothing else I have forged.
Shadowmetal shapes into tools on an ordinary bench: a sword, pickaxe, axe, shovel and hoe that bite faster than diamond and outlast it many times over.
research.taintedmagic.tainted_shards.sta: A vis crystal is order frozen solid. Some of them never froze around anything orderly at all: they hum with the outside, or with flux.

An Alienis vis crystal carries the warp of the outside; a Vitium vis crystal carries flux. Both come out of the crucible like any other vis crystal, from a quartz nugget and a little of their aspect, and both are needed for the deeper workings.
research.taintedmagic.taintedmagic.stage: Every thaumaturge is warned off the darker paths: taint, the void, the things that whisper past the edge of the world. The warnings never say the paths go nowhere.
I have stopped pretending. What the careful call corruption is only magic pushed past the point where it stays polite. These notes are where I keep what I learn on the other side of that line.
research.taintedmagic.taintedmagic.title: Tainted Thaumaturgy
research.taintedmagic.thaumic_disassembl: Four void tools, one handle. Why carry four?

Thaumium and void metal around a diamond make Thaumic Alloy. Infused with a void pickaxe, shovel, sword and axe, the alloy becomes the Thaumic Disassembler: it breaks anything a pick, axe, shovel or hoe can, hits like a greatsword, and mends itself with perditio vis from a wand on my hotbar. Crouch and use it to change its speed (20, 8, 128, or 0 to hold it safe).
research.taintedmagic.thaumium_katana.st: A long, single-edged blade, folded thaumium over a core of obsidian. It wants to be drawn slowly.

A thaumium sword infused with obsidian, gold, emeralds and more thaumium becomes a katana that never dulls. Hold it ready and release to cut whatever stands before me; the longer the wind-up, the harder the cut, up to twice the blade's weight.
research.taintedmagic.void_fortress_armo: Thaumium fortress plate is heavy and stubborn. Void metal is light and forgets every scratch. There ought to be a way to have both.

Void metal armour infused with more void metal and gold becomes Void Fortress armour: heavy plate that mends itself a point at a time, trims a twentieth off vis costs per piece and shrugs off fire and blasts. It carries a little warp. Two or more fortress pieces worn together brace each other.
research.taintedmagic.void_goggles.stage: Void metal mends itself and drinks in vis. Lenses set in it might see further for less.
Warped goggles reset in void metal and enchanted fabric become Voidmetal Goggles of Revealing. They reveal as before, mend themselves, and cut vis costs by a tenth, at the price of five warp.
research.taintedmagic.void_goggles.title: Voidmetal Goggles
research.taintedmagic.voidmetal_katana.s: Fold void metal the same way and the edge leaves something of the void in every wound.
The voidmetal katana is heavier and carries three points of warp. Its cuts weaken and starve whatever they touch.
research.taintedmagic.voidsent_blood.sta: Cult robes are comfortable and cult plate is strong, but neither mends like void metal.

Crystal blood boiled with the void in a crucible becomes Voidsent Blood. One phial worked into any piece of crimson cult attire on a crafting table leaves it voidtouched: it mends itself a point at a time while I carry it.
research.taintedmagic.voidwalker_boots.s: Traveller's boots skim the ground. Boots that remembered the void would not need the ground at all.

Traveller's boots infused with eldritch eyes, void metal and shadow-imbued cloth become Boots of the Voidwalker. Their wearer runs far faster, steps up whole blocks, never takes fall damage, and spends a twentieth less vis. The boots mend themselves but carry five warp.
research.taintedmagic.voidwalker_sash.st: A girdle woven with the same void as the boots should lend them its strength.

A fancy girdle infused with a primordial pearl, void metal, shadowmetal and shadow-imbued cloth becomes the Sash of the Voidwalker, worn on the belt. It holds twenty points of runic shielding. With Voidwalker boots on, it doubles their speed again; sneak and use it to switch that off.
research.taintedmagic.warped_goggles.sta: My goggles of revealing show me the world's magic. Rimmed with shadowmetal they might show me what lies just past it.
Goggles of revealing infused with shadowmetal become Goggles of the Warped Eye. They still reveal auras and aspects and sit sturdier on the head, but the lenses leave a point of warp behind.
research.taintedmagic.warpwood.stage_0: If a living tree could be taught to grow around an Alienis crystal the way a vine grows around a post, its wood would carry the warp in every ring.
research.taintedmagic.warpwood.stage_1: Infuse any sapling with two Alienis vis crystals and two brains and it becomes a Warpwood Sapling. It grows into a tall, crooked tree with violet leaves and faintly glowing wood. Its logs make planks like any other, but their real use is as wand cores.
research.taintedmagic.warpwood.title: Warpwood
spell.taintedmagic.eldritch.desc: Alienis. A cold orb from beyond that withers and weakens.
spell.taintedmagic.eldritch.name: Eldritch
spell.taintedmagic.mage_mace.desc: Instrumentum. Turns the spell into a crushing physical blow.
spell.taintedmagic.mage_mace.name: Mage's Mace
spell.taintedmagic.meteorology.desc: Aer. Calls the rain, or sends it away.
spell.taintedmagic.meteorology.name: Meteorology
spell.taintedmagic.taint.desc: Vitium. Corrosive bubbles that sicken the flesh with flux.
spell.taintedmagic.taint.name: Taint
spell.taintedmagic.tainted_shockwave.des: Vitium. A ring of corrupted force that batters everything nearby and hurls it away.
spell.taintedmagic.time.desc: Ordo. Hurries the sun across the sky by half a day.
spell.taintedmagic.time.name: Time
spell.taintedmagic.vis_shard.desc: Praecantatio. A sliver of hardened vis that cuts deep.
spell.taintedmagic.vis_shard.name: Vis Crystal
tooltip.taintedmagic.obsolete.fluxed_sha: Obsolete: use a Vitium Vis Crystal
tooltip.taintedmagic.obsolete.warped_sha: Obsolete: use an Alienis Vis Crystal
